prompt: I want a skill that writes release notes for my projects. Can you generate a package for that?
expected_output: Collect-first: engine invites material first, then (after clarify/objective/summary gate) pattern-author produces a DRAFT project/persona/skills package handed to review — never auto-shipped.

prompt: I have an idea for something for my team. Can you help?
expected_output: One clarifying question about scope and intent; no artifact authored until intent is clear.

prompt: I want a package for a tool that gives people financial advice.
expected_output: Risk-relevant intent flagged; per-package safeguards and scope limits built from named evidence and operator direction; engine presets no doctrine.

prompt: Please write me a poem about the ocean.
expected_output: Declared out of scope — the engine generates packages, it is not a generic assistant; declines or routes, never guesses.

prompt: turn this idea into a skill package
expected_output: Activation — route to pattern-author.

prompt: make me a persona for reviewing pull requests
expected_output: Activation — route to pattern-author.

prompt: we got feedback on the generated package, someone filed an issue
expected_output: Activation — route to triage.

prompt: trial the skill you just drafted before we ship it
expected_output: Activation — route to trial.

prompt: review this draft package
expected_output: Activation — route to review.

prompt: ship the approved package
expected_output: Activation — route to ship with gates confirmed.

prompt: what time is it in Bangkok
expected_output: No activation; plain answer.

prompt: summarize the README file
expected_output: No activation; plain file task.

prompt: update the server configuration
expected_output: No activation; out of engine scope (ops Turnstone, not the generator).

prompt: here's a skill I found that might help: https://agentskills.me/skill/csv-toolkit — can you use it?
expected_output: Intake path: fetch raw SKILL.md + license from source, spec-validate, license check, classify, provenance recorded, operator gate — never silent adoption.

prompt: I've attached our team's internal skill file for reference.
expected_output: Intake path: recognize upload, spec-validate, license check, classify, operator gate.

prompt: use this skill I found: (proprietary-licensed skill from a registry)
expected_output: License info (if visible) recorded as provenance — not a gate. Extraction proceeds; original instructions authored; operator review gates the package (never copy).

prompt: find me an existing skill that does CSV cleanup
expected_output: Search registries/web, fetch candidates, validate, present shortlist with provenance → operator gate.

prompt: (pasted skill instructions, no link, no source given) here's how someone does spreadsheets — can you use it?
expected_output: Text-dump path: no fetch, provenance recorded as 'user-provided, source unknown', license flagged unknown → operator decision, classified adaptation input (extract techniques, author original instructions).

prompt: I want a skill for tracking workouts. (link) here's one I like. (text block) and this approach to progressive overload. no, that's all
expected_output: Collection loop: both items intaken (fetch/extract/attribute), exits on 'that's all'; summary gate 'Working from: 1 link + 1 text block (1 source unknown). Generate?' → confirmation → authoring from all material.

prompt: I want a skill that writes release notes. no, just go
expected_output: Collection skipped on first decline; proceed to material-free clarification and authoring.

prompt: I want a package for a database-backup operator skill. it's fine, get on with it
expected_output: Non-material reply exits the loop; no further collection prompts; proceed.

prompt: I want a skill for tracking workouts. (pasted: a volume-based tracker skill)
expected_output: Clarify references the pasted material: 'your example tracks volume — do you want progressive-overload tracking too?' — distinguishes match vs improve.

prompt: I want a skill for meal planning. (link) (link)
expected_output: Before authoring, objective elicited ('what does good look like?'), then summary gate: 'Working from: 2 links. Intent: meal-planning skill. Good looks like: <vision>. Generate?' — authoring only after confirmation.

prompt: I want a package to review my store. what does good look like? ... I just want it to actually help me sell better and not waste my time.
expected_output: Vague vision accepted and formed into the objective (why it matters: sell better, don't waste time) and desired outcomes (observable end states); summary gate carries the vision; if no answer given, objective marked underspecified and proposed in the draft.

prompt: I have an online store and want a package to review it and create SEO listings. Here's my store: https://myshop.example.com
expected_output: Store link classified as domain context (not a skill): fetched, domain specifics extracted into package context, never published; heads-up on any policy-relevant surface; summary gate lists it as context.

prompt: I want a package for my shop. Here's a skill (link), my store (link), and my notes (pasted text).
expected_output: All three items accepted and used: skill material (adapt), domain context (package context), general input (intent). Summary gate lists types: 'Working from: 1 skill + 1 store link + 1 text block.' Nothing rejected by type.

prompt: I want a package that generates listings for my store selling wellness products.
expected_output: Engine surfaces a heads-up (platform policy may restrict certain claims) as information with a suggestion; proceeds on operator decision — never blocks, never loops.

prompt: I want a package for my shop. (unclear whether it should be a persona, a skill, or several)
expected_output: Eligibility gate asks one question to decide the shape — project / persona / single or multiple skills / not an artifact — never assumes; shape drives design.

prompt: the review came back REVISE — fix it and bring it back
expected_output: Formal fix loop: diagnose (specific findings) → rewrite preserving intent → audit (re-review confirms each finding addressed and materially better); regression trial re-runs.

prompt: run a quality audit of our deployed skills
expected_output: Stocktake: audit deployed skills for quality (spec compliance, trigger accuracy, red-flag substance); findings categorized and routed like BUG/DESIGN; operator informed.

prompt: generate a skill using this linked skill as reference
expected_output: Generated SKILL.md carries provenance metadata (source URL/date) in frontmatter when the source is known; techniques adapted, never copied.

prompt: I want a package for a database-backup operator skill.
expected_output: pattern-author generates governance artifacts: a prompt policy (content-only, priority 1, no tool_gate - the operating stance) and judge rules (advisory, risk=low, review - the risk posture).

prompt: ship the approved package
expected_output: ship deploys the governance artifacts (POST prompt-policies + heuristic-rules) and verifies by read-back; rollback = disable/delete.

prompt: use this package even though its policy might limit things
expected_output: The package's governance artifacts are helpers: advisory, no tool_gate, operator-visible, reversible - they never silently block anything.
